enum.statLegendNote.人口分母＝戶籍人口（同年 12 月底；不: Population denominator = registered household population (end of December; excludes tourists, commuters and other transient population)
enum.statLegendNote.季初步統計，以年度刑案統計為準: Preliminary quarterly figures; the annual criminal case statistics are authoritative
enum.statLegendNote.毒品案發生地多為查獲地，不等於居民犯罪: Drug-case locations are mostly where the seizure happened, not where offenders live
enum.statLegendNote.斷點：2024 年第 3 季（民國 11: Break: from Q3 2024 quarterly cases jumped to about 7× the previous quarter, cause not identified; compare across 2024 with caution.
enum.statLegendNote.斷點：鄉鎮層 2015–2024 約 5: Break: in 2015–2024 about 55% of cases were recorded only to the county, so the 2025 jump at township level reflects a recording change, not more cases (county level is consistent).
enum.statLegendNote.全國件數 2023 年起連年倍增（1,2: National cases have roughly doubled every year since 2023 (1,268 → 2,340 → 5,427), cause not identified.
enum.statLegendNote.部分期別（2026 年 1–6 月等）只: Partial periods (e.g. Jan–Jun 2026) have case counts only, no rates, and are not comparable with full years.
enum.statLegendNote.0 件自成最淺一級（該區該年無通報事件，: 0 cases forms its own lightest class (no reported incident in that area and year; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0 件（該區該年無通報事件，不: The lightest class includes 0 cases (no reported incident in that area and year; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0（該區該年無通報事件，不是無: The lightest class includes 0 (no reported incident in that area and year; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.只涵蓋臺北市 12 區；其他縣市鄉鎮為未: Covers only the 12 districts of Taipei City; other townships are not covered (not zero).
enum.statLegendNote.依清潔隊清運責任區統計，不等於該區居民產: Counted by the cleaning squad's collection area, not the amount generated by residents of the district.
enum.statLegendNote.12 區加總不等於全市清運量：區隊量含巨: The 12-district sum is not the city total: district squads include bulky waste and exclude returned waste, while the city total also counts directly managed squads and other units.
enum.statLegendNote.累計值（月底）；分母為民政局月底門牌總戶: Cumulative values (end of month); the denominator is the Civil Affairs Bureau's end-of-month count of addressed households.
enum.statLegendNote.108 年 5 月起公式與分類改變，拆成: The formula and categories changed in May 2019, so the series is split into "up to Apr 2019" and "from May 2019"; the two cannot be joined for comparison.
enum.statLegendNote.與縣市版「公共污水下水道用戶接管普及率」: Not comparable with the county-level public sewer connection rate: Taipei is about 100% there, but 82.8% (Dec 2024) on the Sewerage Office's addressed-household basis.
enum.statLegendNote.缺 12 個月（例如 102 年 11: 12 months have no monthly report (e.g. Nov 2013, Jun 2016, Sep 2020); they are not filled with the previous month.
enum.statLegendNote.92–95 年只有合計，沒有產業分項。: 2003–2006 have totals only, with no breakdown by industry.
enum.statLegendNote.來源「-」＝該區該產業無工廠，記為 0: A source "-" means no factories of that industry in the district and is recorded as 0 (a true zero).
enum.statLegendNote.產業分項自 96 年 1 月起；「99: The industry breakdown starts in Jan 2007; "99 Unclassifiable" appears only in some periods.
enum.statLegendNote.0 家自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 factories forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.一張使用執照計 1 件；跨區或無地址的執: Each occupancy permit counts as 1; permits spanning districts or without an address (about 0.64%) are not assigned to any district.
enum.statLegendNote.件數逐張計，95 年起比主計處年表多 6: Counted permit by permit; since 2006 this is 6–21% higher than the DGBAS annual table, which uses a different basis.
enum.statLegendNote.核發使用執照不等於完工入住或新增住宅供給: Issued occupancy permits are not the same as move-ins or new housing supply.
enum.statLegendNote.0 件自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 permits forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.0 棟自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 buildings forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.0 戶自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是: 0 households forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.建築面積是建築物投影面積，不是總樓地板面: Building area is the building footprint, not total floor area.
enum.statLegendNote.0 自成最淺一級（該區當月為 0，不是無: 0 forms its own lightest class (the district had 0 that month; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋（只涵蓋臺北市 12 區；其他縣市: Not covered (only the 12 districts of Taipei City are covered; other townships are not zero)
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋或無資料（臺北市以外未涵蓋；臺北市: Not covered or no data (areas outside Taipei City are not covered; Taipei's 12 districts occasionally have gaps; neither is zero)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：衛生福利部統計處 死因統計（dat: Source: Cause of Death Statistics, Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare (data.gov.tw 5965); Open Government Data License, Version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.0 為該期無死亡（真值，不是無資料）；斜: 0 means no deaths in that period (a true value, not missing data); hatching marks not applicable or no data.
enum.statLegendNote.粗死亡率未做年齡標準化：高齡人口多的地方: Crude death rates are not age-standardized: places with older populations score higher, which does not mean worse health care.
enum.statLegendNote.小鄉鎮人口少，單年數值波動大，建議看 5: Small townships have few residents, so single-year values swing widely; prefer the 5-year totals.
enum.statLegendNote.死亡率分母為 12 月底戶籍人口（衛福部: The rate denominator is the registered household population at the end of December (the Ministry's published national crude death rate uses mid-year population, so values differ slightly); denominators exist only from 2018, so rates start in 2018.
enum.statLegendNote.死因已統一為 109 年起 42 類；C: Causes are harmonized to the 42 categories used from 2020; COVID-19 exists only from 2020.
enum.statLegendNote.5 年平均＝5 年合計死亡數 ÷ 5 年: 5-year average = 5-year total deaths ÷ sum of 5 years of registered population (person-years) × 100,000; only the 2021–2025 window is available.
enum.statLegendNote.人數在有 0 人的組合中，0 人自成最淺: For death counts with zeros, 0 is its own lightest class (no deaths in that period, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0（該期無死亡，不是無資料）。: The lightest color includes 0 (no deaths in that period, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.不適用（COVID-19 自 109 年: Not applicable (the COVID-19 category exists only from 2020)
enum.statLegendNote.小鄉鎮人口少，單年波動大；本層為 5 年: Small townships swing widely year to year; this layer uses 5-year totals, which are steadier, but very small townships should still be read cautiously and not ranked on this basis.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：文化部 文化幣可用藝文消費點（da: Source: Ministry of Culture, Culture Coin participating arts venues (data.gov.tw 177601, downloaded 2026-10-24); Open Government Data License, Version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.名冊登記人數，依登記或聯絡地址所在行政區: Number of people on the roster, counted by the district of their registered or contact address, not where they perform; names are not included.
enum.statLegendNote.0 人自成最淺一級（名冊在該區無登記，不: 0 people is its own lightest class (no one on the roster in that area; not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.臺中市西區 100 人多為登記於草悟道（: Most of the 100 people in Taichung's West District are registered at Calligraphy Greenway (the address only locates to the place name); it does not mean they live in West District.
enum.statLegendNote.名冊為自願登記，臺中市偏多可能反映制度差: Registration is voluntary; Taichung's high count may reflect differences in local licensing schemes, so do not read this as the actual distribution of street performers.
enum.statLegendNote.點位見「文化」主題的「文化幣藝文消費點」: For points, see Culture Coin Venues under the Culture theme (street performers are not included there).
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 國有非公用土地管: Source: National Property Administration, report of state-owned non-public land by management status (data.gov.tw 30583); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 國有非公用房地數: Source: National Property Administration, report of state-owned non-public real estate quantity and value (data.gov.tw 30580); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 歷年國有非公用不: Source: National Property Administration, annual leases of state-owned non-public real estate (data.gov.tw 6720); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財政部國有財產署 國有非公用住宅用: Source: National Property Administration, state-owned non-public residential land table (data.gov.tw 36963); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：台灣糖業股份有限公司 可供出租土地: Source: Taiwan Sugar Corporation, land available for lease (data.gov.tw 25754); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：台灣糖業股份有限公司 資產公告土地: Source: Taiwan Sugar Corporation, announced land details (data.gov.tw 101669); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：法務部行政執行署 所屬分署已拍定不: Source: Administrative Enforcement Agency, real estate sold at auction by its branches (quarterly files by year, data.gov.tw 178752 and others); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.114 年底存量（單一期）。: Stock at the end of 2025 (single period).
enum.statLegendNote.占比分母為未處理土地面積（13 個管理區: The share's denominator is unprocessed land area (sum of the 13 management statuses).
enum.statLegendNote.最淺色含 0（該區為 0，不是無資料）。: The lightest class includes 0 (the area is 0, not missing).
enum.statLegendNote.0 自成最淺一級（該區為 0，不是無資料: 0 forms its own lightest class (the area is 0, not missing).
enum.statLegendNote.管理區分含「未處理土地」「已處理土地」兩: Management status includes two subtotals (unprocessed and processed land); do not add across statuses. Processed land is no longer in the current stock.
enum.statLegendNote.每平方公尺價值只供縣市間比較，不可乘回面: Value per m² is only for comparing counties; do not multiply it back by area or add it up into a total value of state property (the source does not say whether it is book value or announced current value).
enum.statLegendNote.不適用（該類面積為 0，沒有單位價值）: Not applicable (area of this category is 0, so no unit value)
enum.statLegendNote.分類含「土地」「房屋」兩個小計，不可跨類: Categories include two subtotals (land and buildings); do not add across categories. Building area is floor area of the structures.
enum.statLegendNote.91–99 年臺中、臺南、高雄為改制前縣: For 2002–2010, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung are the combined values of the former county and city; Lienchiang has no data for 2002–2004.
enum.statLegendNote.無資料（連江縣 91–93 年來源為「-: No data (Lienchiang 2002–2004 is "-" in the source, not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.台糖公告「可供出租」的土地清單，不是台糖: Taisugar's published list of land available for lease, not the total land Taisugar holds. Townships not on the list are not covered (hatched), not 0.
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋（台糖清單未列此鄉鎮，不是 0）: Not covered (township not on Taisugar's list, not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.歷年標租標的，非持有地（2016 年起至: Past lease tender items, not land held (cumulative announcements from 2016 to the download date). Townships not on the list are not covered (hatched), not 0.
enum.statLegendNote.公告列數未去重（同地號被公告幾次就計幾次: Listings are not deduplicated (a lot announced several times is counted each time); area and lot counts are deduplicated by lot.
enum.statLegendNote.行政執行（欠稅、罰鍰等）拍賣的已拍定件數: Counts of properties sold at administrative enforcement auctions (unpaid taxes, fines, etc.). Not state property, excludes court auctions, and does not represent the local housing market; the source has no amounts.
enum.statLegendNote.2026 年只到 9 月 30 日（部分: 2026 only runs to 30 September (partial year); do not compare with full years.
enum.statLegendNote.某縣市當年有標的未填鄉鎮時，該縣市所有鄉: If any item in a county lacks a township in a year, all its townships are marked no data (hatched) for that year, not 0. Small townships fluctuate widely from year to year.
enum.statLegendNote.無資料（該縣市當年有標的未填鄉鎮，鄉鎮值: No data (some items in this county lack a township this year, so township values are incomplete; not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 金融卡-AT: Source: FISC, financial-card ATMs by county (data.gov.tw 24357); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.加入財金跨行系統的金融卡 ATM 機台數: Number of financial-card ATM machines on the FISC interbank network, not the number of sites; for sites see township ATM Sites.
enum.statLegendNote.每萬人只在有戶籍人口快照的期別計算（各年: Per 10,000 people is computed only for periods with a household-registration population snapshot (each December and August 2026); other months are not extrapolated.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：金融監督管理委員會銀行局 金融服務: Source: Banking Bureau, FSC, list of financially underserved townships (data.gov.tw 119808); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.判定依據：金管會金管銀合字第 11002: Basis: category 1 of "areas needing more financial branches" under FSC Order Jin-Guan-Yin-He-Zi No. 11002745482 (no domestic bank or credit cooperative, and population served per financial institution above the national average); as of 2026-06-30, 48 townships in 14 counties. The category 2 list is not published and is not shown.
enum.statLegendNote.0＝不在名單（不是缺值，也不代表當地金融: 0 = not on the list (not missing, and it does not mean financial services there are sufficient).
enum.statLegendNote.只有名單內 48 鄉鎮有值；屏東獅子鄉、: Only the 48 listed townships have values; Shizi (Pingtung), Wanrong (Hualien) and Jinfeng (Taitung) have 0 institutions of every type (including post offices and farmers' associations).
enum.statLegendNote.不在名單（來源未提供，不是 0）: Not on the list (not provided by the source, not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：中央銀行金融業務檢查處 各縣市金融: Source: Department of Financial Inspection, Central Bank, financial institutions by county (data.gov.tw 13653); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.基準日 115/09/30；總機構與分行: As of 2026-09-30; head offices and branches each count as one unit, other sub-branch units are not counted.
enum.statLegendNote.金門縣、連江縣來源合併為「金馬地區」一列: Kinmen and Lienchiang are merged into one "Kinmen-Matsu" row in the source and are not split, so both counties show no data (hatched).
enum.statLegendNote.無資料（金門、連江來源合併計算未拆分；不: No data (Kinmen and Lienchiang are merged in the source and not split; not 0)
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 總分支機構位: Source: FISC, head office and branch locations (data.gov.tw 24323); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.依名冊地址計數（下載日 2026-10-: Counted from roster addresses (downloaded 2026-10-24); only branches of domestic, foreign and mainland-Chinese banks, credit cooperatives, and farmers' and fishermen's association credit departments. For post offices see the Post Offices layer.
enum.statLegendNote.本國銀行比央行統計略多（名冊含營業部、國: Domestic banks are slightly higher than the central bank's count (the roster includes non-branch units such as business and international departments).
enum.statLegendNote.每萬人以戶籍人口（2026 年 8 月）: Per 10,000 people uses the household-registration population (August 2026) as the denominator.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 金融機構 A: Source: FISC, ATM locations and head office/branch locations (data.gov.tw 24333, 24323); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.地址只寫市名或解析不到時，依定位點所在鄉: When an address gives only the city or cannot be parsed, the township is taken from the point's location.
enum.statLegendNote.ATM 為「裝設點」數（同一地點多台算一: ATMs are counted as sites (several machines at one place count once), not machines; downloaded 2026-10-24.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：行政院主計總處 工業及服務業普查: Source: DGBAS, Industry and Service Census, finance and insurance establishments by county and detailed industry (data.gov.tw 122340); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.場所單位＝金融及保險業的營業處所（銀行分: Establishments are places of business in finance and insurance (bank branches, securities firms, insurance agencies, investment advisers, etc.), not companies; regional subtotals are excluded.
enum.statLegendNote.105→110 年多項行業大幅變動（如其: Several industries changed sharply from 2016 to 2021 (e.g. other financial services +63%, investment advisory +99%) for reasons not verified; view the two censuses separately rather than comparing change.
enum.statLegendNote.每萬人＝場所單位數 ÷ 110 年底戶籍: Per 10,000 people = establishments ÷ household-registration population at end-2021 × 10,000; 2021 only (no denominator for 2016).
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 金融卡交易、: Source: FISC, monthly county distribution of financial-card transactions, interbank remittances and international-card withdrawals (data.gov.tw 24356, 24348, 24367); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.口徑是交易發生地（交易系統記錄的縣市），: Counted by where the transaction occurred (the county recorded by the system), not where cardholders live; do not read it as residents' spending, income or financial activity.
enum.statLegendNote.跨行通匯臺北占 5–6 成，疑為依入帳機: Taipei accounts for 50–60% of interbank remittances, likely because they are counted where the receiving institution is, not where people are; do not read it as spending or income. Each transaction type has its own color scale.
enum.statLegendNote.「其他非實體通路」不屬任何縣市、不併入地: "Other non-physical channels" belong to no county and are not mapped: 59.37% of financial-card transactions in September 2026 (17.50% in January 2012) and 3.39% of international-card withdrawals; interbank remittances have no such column.
enum.statLegendNote.0 代表不到約 50 筆（來源四捨五入到: 0 means fewer than about 50 transactions (the source rounds to 0.01 × 10,000), not none.
enum.statLegendNote.結構比＝占該類型全部交易的百分比；金融卡: Share = percentage of all transactions of that type; for financial-card transactions and international-card withdrawals the denominator includes non-physical channels, so the 22 counties sum to less than 100%.
enum.statLegendNote.0 代表占比不到 0.005%（來源四捨: 0 means a share below 0.005% (the source rounds to 0.01%), not no transactions.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財團法人保險事業發展中心 最近一年: Source: Taiwan Insurance Institute, life insurer branch offices in the latest year (data.gov.tw 24593); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.臺中市為來源兩列合計（2025 年分公司: Taichung is the sum of two source rows (2025: 12 + 3 branch offices, 417 + 43 sales offices); the source does not explain the second row, but only the sum matches the source total.
enum.statLegendNote.通訊處是壽險公司的業務單位，來源只有各縣: Sales offices are life insurers' sales units; the source gives only counts by county, no addresses.
enum.statLegendNote.出典：財金資訊股份有限公司 金融卡特約商: Source: FISC, financial-card (debit) merchants (data.gov.tw 24315); Open Government Data License, version 1.0.
enum.statLegendNote.金融卡（簽帳）特約商店名冊，不是所有商店: A roster of merchants accepting financial (debit) cards, not all shops; shops that take only credit cards or mobile payments are not included.
enum.statLegendNote.期別＝下載日 2026-10-24；上游: Period = download date 2026-10-24; the source file has no data date.
enum.statLegendNote.已排除全國同址超過 200 家的 9 個: Excludes 9 addresses with more than 200 merchants each nationwide (5,489 in total: payment platforms, taxi fleets and chain headquarters registering in bulk).
enum.statLegendNote.每萬人＝排除集中登記地址後的家數 ÷ 戶: Per 10,000 people = merchants after excluding bulk addresses ÷ household-registration population (August 2026) × 10,000.
enum.statLegendNote.新竹市約 8.3%、嘉義市約 11.5%: About 8.3% of addresses in Hsinchu City and 11.5% in Chiayi City lack a district and cannot be assigned, so district values there are low (1,937 merchants, 0.47%, unassigned nationwide).
enum.statLegendNote.0 自成最淺一級（如金門烏坵鄉為 0，不: 0 is its own lightest class (e.g. Wuqiu, Kinmen is 0, not missing).
enum.statLegendNote.含集中登記地址，會灌高總部所在區（如臺北: Includes bulk-registered addresses, which inflate headquarters districts (e.g. Nangang, Taipei: 4,606, or 2,372 after exclusion); for general comparison use the bulk-excluded version.
enum.statLegendNote.同址多店算一處（夜市、市場攤商會被壓成一: Several merchants at one address count once (night-market and market stalls collapse into one).
enum.statLegendNote.英格蘭與威爾斯由 ONS 推估，蘇格蘭來: England and Wales are estimated by ONS, Scotland by NRS and Northern Ireland by NISRA; the methods differ, so compare across nations with caution.
enum.statLegendNote.蘇格蘭數字四捨五入到 10 人。: Scottish figures are rounded to the nearest 10 people.
enum.statLegendNote.距 2021 年普查越遠的年份，推估誤差: The further a year is from the 2021 census, the larger the estimation error.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Source: Office fo: Attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0
enum.statLegendNote.人口密度的分母是陸地面積，不含潮間帶與水: Density uses land area as the denominator, excluding intertidal areas and inland water.
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋：蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭（來源不含這些地: Not covered: Scotland and Northern Ireland (not in the source; not 0).
enum.statLegendNote.英格蘭、威爾斯與蘇格蘭的鄉村定義不同，分: England & Wales and Scotland define “rural” differently, so they are separate layers and cannot be compared directly; Northern Ireland has no official rural share at local authority level.
enum.statLegendNote.鄉村＝ONS 2021 城鄉分類中歸為鄉: Rural = census output areas (OAs) classed as rural in the ONS 2021 Rural Urban Classification; based on 2021 census population.

Source: Office for National Statistics (Rural Urban Classification 2021, supplementary tables); Scottish Government / National Records of Scotland (Urban Rural Classification 2022, Census 2022 population estimates).
enum.statLegendNote.0% 自成最淺一級（該區沒有鄉村人口，是: 0% is its own lightest class (the district has no rural population; an official value, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.主要城鎮＝建成區人口 75,000 人以: Major town = built-up area of 75,000 people or more; far = more than 30 minutes’ drive.
enum.statLegendNote.0% 自成最淺一級（該區人口都在主要城鎮: 0% is its own lightest class (everyone in the district lives within 30 minutes’ drive of a major town; an official value, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋：英格蘭、威爾斯、北愛爾蘭（來源不: Not covered: England, Wales and Northern Ireland (not in the source; not 0).
enum.statLegendNote.蘇格蘭的鄉村＝居住地人口不到 3,000: In Scotland, rural = settlements of fewer than 3,000 people (Accessible rural + Remote rural combined); based on 2022 census population.
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋：威爾斯、蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭（來源不: Not covered: Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland (not in the source; not 0).
enum.statLegendNote.英國四地的剝奪指數方法、指標、年份都不同: The four UK nations’ deprivation indices differ in method, indicators and year; each has its own legend and they cannot be compared across nations. Ranks are meaningful only within each nation.
enum.statLegendNote.分數越高越剝奪；為區內小區（LSOA）分: Higher scores mean more deprived; the official population-weighted summary of the district’s small-area (LSOA) scores.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Contains public s: Attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: MHCLG, English Indices of Deprivation 2025 (File 10, LAD summaries lower-tier v2).
enum.statLegendNote.該區小區（LSOA）中，落在全英格蘭最剝: Share of the district’s small areas (LSOAs) in England’s most deprived 10% (official summary value).
enum.statLegendNote.0% 自成最淺一級（該區沒有小區落在最剝: 0% is its own lightest class (none of the district’s small areas is in the most deprived 10%; an official value, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋：英格蘭、蘇格蘭、北愛爾蘭（來源不: Not covered: England, Scotland and Northern Ireland (not in the source; not 0).
enum.statLegendNote.官方門檻：全威爾斯 1,917 個小區（: Official thresholds: ranks 1–191 (10%) / 1–382 (20%) among Wales’s 1,917 small areas (LSOAs).
enum.statLegendNote.授權：gov.wales 版權聲明載明可: Licence: the gov.wales copyright statement allows re-use under the Open Government Licence (no version stated; it links to v3).
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Source: Welsh Gov: Attribution: Source: Welsh Government, WIMD 2025 local authority deprivation profiles (StatsWales). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence.
enum.statLegendNote.依官方排名門檻，由全蘇格蘭 6,976: Aggregated from the ranks of Scotland’s 6,976 small areas (data zones, 2011 version) using the official thresholds; the data year is 2020, older than England’s and Wales’s.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Contains public s: Attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: Scottish Government, Scottish Index of Multiple Deprivation 2020v2.
enum.statLegendNote.未涵蓋：英格蘭、威爾斯、蘇格蘭（來源不含: Not covered: England, Wales and Scotland (not in the source; not 0).
enum.statLegendNote.官方沒有發布這一層的占比；依官方排名自行: No official figure is published at this level; aggregated here from the official ranks (rank 89 or better / 178 or better among Northern Ireland’s 890 small areas, SOAs). The data year is 2017, older than England’s and Wales’s.
enum.statLegendNote.授權依據為 OpenDataNI 同資料: The licence basis is the UK Open Government Licence shown on the same dataset’s OpenDataNI page; NISRA’s own site states only © Crown Copyright.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Source: NISRA, No: Attribution: Source: NISRA, Northern Ireland Multiple Deprivation Measure 2017 (NIMDM2017). Licensed under the Open Government Licence (per OpenDataNI listing).
enum.statLegendNote.UK HPI 平均房價是混合調整指數換算: The UK HPI average price is derived from a mix-adjusted index, not an average of sale prices; areas with few sales fluctuate more.
enum.statLegendNote.每年取 8 月一期；北愛為季資料，202: One period per year (August). Northern Ireland data are quarterly; August 2026 is marked no data because Q3 has not been published yet.
enum.statLegendNote.Isles of Scilly 在 UK: The Isles of Scilly are merged into Cornwall in the UK HPI and have no separate value; marked no data.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Contains HM Land: Attribution: Contains HM Land Registry data © Crown copyright and database right 2026. This data is licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
enum.statLegendNote.與去年同月相比的 12 個月變動（%）；: 12-month change against the same month last year (%); brown = fall, purple = rise.
enum.statLegendNote.PIPR 是存量租約的平均月租，不是新租: PIPR is the average monthly rent across existing tenancies, not asking rents for new lets; it is an ONS official statistic in development and may be revised.
enum.statLegendNote.蘇格蘭、北愛只有租屋市場區（BRMA）層: Scotland and Northern Ireland are published only by rental market area (BRMA), not by local authority, so they are not covered.
enum.statLegendNote.City of London 與 Isl: The City of London and the Isles of Scilly have no separate values; marked no data.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Source: Office fo: Attribution: Source: Office for National Statistics, Price Index of Private Rents, UK: monthly price statistics (21 October 2026 edition), licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
enum.statLegendNote.與去年同月相比的租金指數變動（%）；棕色: Change in the rent index against the same month last year (%); brown = fall, purple = rise; small areas with few records fluctuate more.
enum.statLegendNote.0 公頃自成最淺一級（該區沒有蔬果面積，: 0 ha is its own lightest class (the area has no fruit or vegetable land; this is an official value, not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.其他耕作物＝不含穀物的耕作物（如油菜、甜: Other arable crops = arable crops excluding cereals (e.g. oilseed rape, sugar beet, potatoes, pulses); area ÷ total area on holdings.
enum.statLegendNote.分級：多數地方行政區很小、少數集中產區很: Classes: most districts are small and a few producing areas are very large, so the 50 / 250 / 1,000 ha thresholds grow about 4–5× per class (log spacing).
enum.statLegendNote.占比分母為同表「農戶總面積」；四類不涵蓋: The share denominator is “total area on holdings” from the same table; the four categories do not cover all land use (fallow, woodland, etc. are excluded), so they do not add up to 100%.
enum.statLegendNote.原始值 0 是官方數值（該區沒有此類面積: A source value of 0 is official (the area has none of this land), not missing data.
enum.statLegendNote.沒有商業農戶的地方行政區，蔬果面積是官方: In districts with no commercial holdings, the fruit & vegetables area is an official 0 (not missing data).
enum.statLegendNote.沒有商業農戶（農戶總面積為 0）的地方行: Districts with no commercial holdings (total area on holdings is 0) have no computable share; they are marked “No holdings”, not 0.
enum.statLegendNote.穀物面積 ÷ 農戶總面積。: Cereals area ÷ total area on holdings.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：Defra, Structure: Attribution: Defra, Structure of the agricultural industry in England at June 2025 (OGL v3.0). Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
enum.statLegendNote.英格蘭商業農戶抽樣調查推估（Defra: Sample-survey estimates for commercial holdings in England (Defra June Survey, June 2025); estimates carry sampling error.
enum.statLegendNote.草地（5 年內暫時草地、5 年以上永久草: Grassland (temporary grass under 5 years, permanent grass 5 years and over, and sole-right rough grazing) area ÷ total area on holdings.
enum.statLegendNote.遮蔽＝涉及少於 5 戶而由來源抑制，或為: Suppressed = withheld by the source because fewer than 5 holdings are involved, or secondarily suppressed to protect another suppressed cell; it is not 0 and must not be back-calculated. If the numerator or denominator of a share is suppressed, the share is suppressed too.
enum.statLegendNote.面積依農戶歸戶到農戶所在的地方行政區，不: Areas are allocated to the district where the holding is based, not where the land actually lies.
enum.statLegendNote.住民登錄人口（2026-09-30），不: Resident registration population (30 Sep 2026), excluding unregistered foreign nationals; comparable in concept to Taiwan's household registration population.
enum.statLegendNote.60 個出張所的人口已依代碼計入所屬市郡: The population of 60 branch offices (chuljangso) is counted in their parent municipality and province by code.
enum.statLegendNote.市郡區共 256 個（含一般區）；世宗特: 256 municipalities including non-autonomous districts; Sejong has a single tier.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：행정안전부, 지역별(행정동) 성: Attribution: 행정안전부, 지역별(행정동) 성별 연령별 주민등록 인구수（2026-09-30 기준）, 공공데이터포털 15097972
enum.statLegendNote.2024 年統計（登錄普查，含外國人），: 2024 statistics (register-based census, including foreign nationals); year and definition differ from the resident registration population (30 Sep 2026), so do not divide or mix them.
enum.statLegendNote.來源為 2024 年統計廳舊界，已對應到: Source uses 2024 Statistics Korea boundaries, mapped to October 2026 boundaries; the 8 districts created after July 2025 have no data
enum.statLegendNote.全南光州統合特別市的道級值，是以 202: The province-level value for Jeonnam-Gwangju is recomputed from the combined numerators and denominators of 2024 Gwangju and South Jeolla.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：국가데이터처 SGIS, 행정구역: Attribution: 국가데이터처 SGIS, 행정구역 통계 및 경계（2024년 통계, 2025년 2분기 경계）, 공공데이터포털 15129688
enum.statLegendNote.只涵蓋首爾 25 區，其他地區未涵蓋（不: Covers only the 25 districts of Seoul; other areas are not covered (not zero).
enum.statLegendNote.全日＝24 小時平均；日間＝09–18: 24-hour = average of all hours; daytime = 09:00–18:00 average; night-time = 00:00–06:00 average.
enum.statLegendNote.電信推估的在地人數（內國人），不是住民登: Telecom-based estimate of people present (Korean nationals), not the resident registration population; do not divide or mix with it.
enum.statLegendNote.只取 2026 年 7 月一個月的月平均: Monthly average for July 2026 only; not representative of the whole year.
enum.statLegendNote.署名：출처: 서울특별시（서울 열린데이: Attribution: 출처: 서울특별시（서울 열린데이터광장）, 행정동 단위 서울 생활인구(내국인)
enum.statLegendNote.日夜生活人口比＝日間（09–18 時平均: Day/night ratio = daytime (09:00–18:00 average) ÷ night-time (00:00–06:00 average) × 100; above 100 means net daytime inflow.
enum.statLegendNote.一般戶，不含集體戶。: Private households only; collective households excluded.
enum.statLegendNote.來源只到小數 1 位，也沒有戶內人口總數: The source rounds to one decimal and gives no household population total, so the province level cannot be recomputed and only municipalities are shown.
enum.statLegendNote.事業體與從業人員為 2024 年全國事業: Establishments and persons employed follow the 2024 Census on Establishments.
